# World layout, Flowing line on: a phrase in the other reading direction must stay on the line's rows (no row starting
# far to the side), read in its own order, and touch nothing. Compare a branch with main by running it twice.
# Run: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=26.3 -f mod_ref=<branch or commit> -f script=.github/checks/world-mixed-rows.txt

cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set layout WORLD
set worldFlow true
set worldClearMiddle true
look 0 0
sleep 6
lines השירים שלנו עולים Under The Bright Night Sky כל הלילה עד הבוקר ועוד קצת אחרי זה כדי שהשורה תהיה ארוכה מאוד
seek 0
sleep 6
shot mixed-he-level-a
sleep 5
shot mixed-he-level-b

look 0 -30
lines We keep on singing שיר של לילה ארוך all the way across the sky until the morning comes back again
seek 0
sleep 6
shot mixed-en-up30-a
sleep 5
shot mixed-en-up30-b

look 0 30
lines We keep on singing שיר של לילה ארוך all the way across the sky until the morning comes back again
seek 0
sleep 6
shot mixed-en-down30-a
sleep 5
shot mixed-en-down30-b
